z-m-01-07.title: Xa wongeza, ngaba ihlala inkulu kunokuqala?
z-m-01-07.goal: Funda ukuba ukugweba isibango ufuna ulwazi 'luninzi kangakanani oludityaniswayo', yenza umzekelo ochasayo ngokudibanisa i-0, uze ulungise isibango kunye nomqathango waso.
z-m-01-07.material: Kukho iimabhulu ezi-5 kwibhokisi yeemabhulu. U-Jian wathi, "Ukuba ufaka iimabhulu ezininzi kwibhokisi yeemabhulu, ihlala kukho iimabhulu ezininzi kunokuqala!" (Iimabhulu azikhutshwa kwibhokisi; zifakwa kuphela.)
z-m-01-07.thinking.0: Ukumisela ukuba ulwazi olufunekayo lunjani ukugweba
z-m-01-07.prereq.0: Isakhono sokubala nokudibanisa amanani ukuya kutsho kwi-10, nokwazi ukuba i-0 ithetha 'akukho nto'
z-m-01-07.s.s1.prompt: U-Jian wathi, 'Ukuba ufaka iimabhulu ezininzi kwibhokisi yeemabhulu, ihlala kukho iimabhulu ezininzi kunasekuqaleni.' Yintoni enye ekufuneka uyazi ukuze wazi ukuba oku kulunge na?
z-m-01-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ngeemabhulu ezi-5 ebhokisini, cinga ngemeko yokufaka imabhulu e-1 neyokufaka iimabhulu ezi-3.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tshintsha inani leemabhulu ozifakayo ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo ufumane ukuba ngawaphi amanani enza isibango singalunganga.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.r.a: Oku kukucinga okuthandabuza ukuba kunokuxhomekeka kwinani elifakiweyo.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.r.b: Umbala awunanto yokwenza nokuba neemabhulu ezininzi okanye ezimbalwa. Kufuneka ufumane ulwazi olunxulumene nenani leemabhulu.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.r.c: Nokuba ibhokisi inkulu okanye incinci, inani leemabhulu ezingaphakathi linokubalwa ngokwahlukileyo. Lulwazi olungahambelaniyo nokuba zibakho ezininzi.
z-m-01-07.s.s1.explain: Amagama athi 'faka ezininzi' awatsho ukuba zifakwa ezingaphi. Kufuneka wazi inani elongeziweyo ukugweba ukuba zininzi kunokuqala.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.prompt: Khetha inani lokuqala leemabhulu nenani leemabhulu ezifakiweyo, yenza iimeko ezi-2, ngamanani okuqala ahlukileyo, apho kungekho mabhulu amaninzi kunokuqala. (Iimabhulu zokuqala ziyi-1 okanye ngaphezulu nama-20 okanye ngaphantsi.)
z-m-01-07.s.s2.hint.0: Tshintsha inani leemabhulu ozifakayo, uze ubhale phantsi ukuba zininzi na kunokuqala.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba lelona nani lifakiweyo elishiya iimabhulu ezibhokisini zingatshintshanga.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Iigoli zokuqala ziyi-1 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye ziyi-20 okanye ngaphantsi.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Bhala iigoli zokuqala njengenani lendalo elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-20.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Inani leegoli ezifakiweyo li-0 okanye ngaphezulu.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Bhala inani leegoli ezifakiweyo njengenani lendalo eli-0 okanye ngaphezulu.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Azinyukanga iigoli ngaphezu kokuqala. Ibango likaJian liyaphuka.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Ziyi-nkulu iigoli kunokuqala. Khetha inani elifakiweyo kwakhona.
z-m-01-07.s.s2.explain: Ukuba iigoli ezi-0 ziyafakwa, iigoli zihlala njengoko zazinjalo. Kuyafana nokuba inani lokuqala liyintoni. Ngoko ibango elithi 'ukuba ufaka ezininzi, zihlala zininzi' lifuna imeko 'ukuba ufaka nokuba yi-1'.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.prompt: Phinda ubhale ibango likaJian ngokuchanekileyo. Libhale ukuze libonise nini iigoli zininzi kunokuqala nanini zingenjalo.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.hint.0: Kwimizekelo oyenzileyo ngasentla, zingaphi ezifakiweyo? Thetha okwenzeka kwiigoli ngoko.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.hint.1: Beka ecaleni kwelinye imeko yokufaka igoli e-1 neyokufaka i-0 ubhale isivakalisi esinye.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ibango lam elilungisiweyo lichaza zombini imeko yokufaka i-0 neyokufaka i-1 okanye ngaphezulu?
z-m-01-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba lithi into efanayo nokuba inani lokuqala leegoli liyintoni?
z-m-01-07.s.s3.model.0: Ukuba ufaka i-1 okanye ngaphezulu, zininzi kunokuqala. Kodwa ukuba ufaka i-0, zihlala zinjalo.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba awufaki nto, azikhuli kwaye zihlala zifana nokuqala. Ukuba ufaka nokuba yinye, ziba ninzi.
z-m-01-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Impendulo ethi intsingiselo efanayo ngaphandle kwegama elithi '0'.

z-m-01-03.thinking.1: Ukufumana iimeko apho isibakala sisebenza khona
z-m-01-03.title: Ukutshintsha ulandelelwano kunika ixabiso elifanayo?
z-m-01-03.goal: Nciphisa, kancinci kancinci ngolwazi olutsha, uluhlu apho isibhengezo 'ukutshintsha ulandelelwano kunika ixabiso elifanayo' silunge khona, uze ufumane amatyala apho ulandelelwano lungenakutshintshwa.
z-m-01-03.material: U-Seoyun wayethetha ngeelekese waza wathi, 'Xa ubala ngamanani amabini, ufumana ixabiso elifanayo nokuba utshintsha ulandelelwano.' Masijonge ulwazi icandelo linye ngexesha sicinge ngokuba isibhengezo sika-Seoyun silunge kangakanani. Iilekese azinakwahlulwa okanye zenziwe ngokungekho nto, kwaye awunakutya ngaphezulu kwezo unazo.

z-m-01-03.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana into enye eyahlukileyo kwiinkcukacha ezintsha xa kuthelekiswa nokuqala.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.hint.1: Thetha ukuba isibhengezo sika-Seoyun silunge kweziphi iimeko nasezingeyonguwe.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Dibanisa ipleyiti eneelekese ezi-3 nepleyiti eneelekese ezi-5. I-3 ne-5 kunye zenza i-8. Ukuba utshintsha ulandelelwano udibanise i-5 ne-3, nayo yi-8. U-Seoyun uthe, 'Xa ubala ngamanani amabini, ufumana ixabiso elifanayo nokuba utshintsha ulandelelwano.'

z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Esi sigwebo sahlula imeko esiyibonileyo (ukudibanisa) kumatyala singawabonanga.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kukho isibini sodwa semizekelo, ngoko asinakuqiniseka nokuba kukudibanisa
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Esi sigwebo sinobuchule malunga nokuba nemizekelo embalwa. Yingcinga yokujonga ngemizekelo engakumbi.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kholelwa ukuba rhoqo kulungile kuko konke ukubala ngamanani amabini
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Oku kwandise imizekelo yokudibanisa kuko konke ukubala. Asikajongi ukubala okususa okanye okufumana okuseleyo.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Sijonge imizekelo engakumbi yokudibanisa. I-4 ne-6 zenza i-10, kwaye i-6 ne-4 nazo zenza i-10. I-0 ne-7 zenza i-7, kwaye i-7 ne-0 nazo zenza i-7. Ngeli xesha, cinga ngokutya ezi-4 kwiilekese ezi-9. Kuseleyo iilekese ezi-5. Ukuba utshintsha ulandelelwano, 'ukutya ezi-9 kwiilekese ezi-4' akunakwenziwa, ngoko oku kubala kuya kufuna ukubala esingakafundi.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngokusekelwe koko ukubonileyo ngoku, ucinga ntoni ngesibhengezo sika-Seoyun?
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Imizekelo yokudibanisa iqhubeke ilungile, kwaye imeko apho ulandelelwano lungenakutshintshwa yavela kuphela kwimeko yokutya. Isigwebo esicinga ngokwahlukileyo ngoluhlu apho isibhengezo silunge khona siyafaneleka.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Xa kudityaniswa kulungile, kodwa xa kutyiwa kukho amaxesha apho akufuneki utshintshe ulandelelwano
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Sahlula imeko yokudibanisa neyokutya saza sancitha uluhlu apho isibhengezo silunge khona.

z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Umzekelo wokutya wawungalunganga, ngoko ngoku asinakuyithemba nemeko yokudibanisa

z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Masilungise isibhengezo sika-Seoyun ngokongeza imeko. Phakathi kwamatyala okutya, ukuba utya ezi-5 kwiilekese ezi-5, kuseleyo ezi-0. Kule meko, nokuba utshintsha ulandelelwano lukwakukubala okufanayo, ngoko li-0. Kodwa kukho amatyala apho ulandelelwano lungenakutshintshwa, njengokutya ezi-4 kwezi-9.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Khetha eyona ndlela ilungileyo yokulungisa isibhengezo sika-Seoyun.

z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Xa udibanisa amanani amabini, ufumana ixabiso elifanayo nokuba utshintsha ulandelelwano

z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kukubala ngamanani amabini, nokuba kudityaniswa okanye kutyiwa, ixabiso lihlala lifana xa utshintsha ulandelelwano

z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Xa sidibanisa kuyafana, kodwa xa sidla zikho amaxesha apho akufuneki utshintshe ulandelelwano
z-m-01-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Le ngxelo ihlukanisa imeko yokudibanisa neyokutya.
z-m-01-03.s.s1.reflect: Ulwazi lokuqala lwalumalunga nokudibanisa kuphela, ngoko sasingakwazi uluhlu apho isibango silungile khona. Njengoko ulwazi olutsha lwalufika, ingaba weza kuhlula iimeko ezilungileyo nezo zingalunganga?
z-m-01-03.s.s2.prompt: Kumanani amabini a no-b ukusuka kwi-0 ukuya kwi-20, fumana iimeko ezi-2 ezahlukileyo apho zombini 'ukutya b ukusuka ku-a' kunye 'nokutya a ukusuka ku-b' zinokwenziwa. (Ukuba inani ofuna ukulitya likhulu kunelo unalo, akunakwenziwa.)

z-m-01-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Bhala onke amanani omabini njengamanani emvelo asuka kwi-0 ukuya kwi-20.
z-m-01-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukutya b ukusuka ku-a, a akufuneki ibe ncinci kune-b.

z-m-01-03.s.s2.explain: Kuphela xa inani ofuna ukulitya lilingana nelo unalo kunokwenziwa kwakubini emva kokutshintsha ulandelelwano, kwaye emva koko inani eliseleyo li-0. Kufuneka uqale ujonge ukuba ukubala kunokwenziwa emva kokutshintsha ulandelelwano.

z-m-01-01.title: Iindlela zokwabelana ngeemabula ezi-9 phakathi kweengxowa ezimbini
z-m-01-01.goal: Bonisa ngokuzenzela ukuba zininzi iindlela zokwahlula i-9 ibe ngamanani amabini, uze uchaze indlela yokuzibala ungatsibi nanye.
z-m-01-01.material: Zikho iimabula ezi-9. Ufuna ukuzifaka zonke kwiingxowa ezimbini, ingxowa ebomvu neluhlaza, ungashiyi nanye. Ingxowa nganye ifumana i-1 ubuncinane. Iingxowa ezimbini zinemibala eyahlukileyo, ngoko unokuzahlula. U-Mina uthe, 'Kukho indlela enye kuphela yokwabelana ngeemabula ezi-9 phakathi kweengxowa ezimbini.'

z-m-01-01.s.s1.r.c: Oku kukucinga kokuzama ngqo ukuba ezinye iimeko ziyakho ngokutshintsha indlela yokwahlula.

z-m-01-01.s.s2.prompt: Wahlula zonke iimabula ezi-9 ukuze ingxowa ebomvu ibe neemabula ezininzi kuneluhlaza. Yenza iindlela ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo. Ingxowa nganye ifumana i-1 ubuncinane.

z-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Ingxowa ebomvu kufuneka ibe neemabula ezininzi kuneluhlaza.
z-m-01-01.s.s2.explain: Ukufaka iimabula ezi-5, 6, 7, okanye ezi-8 kwingxowa ebomvu, zonke iindlela ezi-4 ziyenzeka. Nje ukuba inani lengxowa ebomvu limiselwe, inani lengxowa eluhlaza limiselwe nalo, ngoko inani elahlukileyo kwingxowa ebomvu lithetha indlela eyahlukileyo.

z-m-01-06.title: Ingaba isivakalisi esinye sengxelo sinokuhambelana neebali ezininzi?

z-m-01-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kubali ngalinye, bhala ukuba 12 no-5 zithetha ntoni nganye.
z-m-01-06.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba oko ibali ngalinye lifuna ukukufumana 'linani elikhulu kune-12' okanye 'linani elincinci kune-12'.

z-m-01-04.goal: Fumana kwisisombululo esisebenzileyo ukungaqondi ukuba '=' luphawu lokubhala impendulo kuphela, uze ugwebe ukuba izivakalisi zamanani zinyanisile okanye azinyani ngentsingiselo yokuba macala omabini alingana.
z-m-01-04.material: U-Jiho wasombulula ingxaki yokufumana inani elingena kwi-□ kwi-3+4=□+2. Jonga isisombululo sika-Jiho umgca ngomgca ucinge ukuba '=' ibonisa ntoni. ('3+4' ifundwa 'ntathu kongeza ne-4', kwaye '□' ifundwa 'ibhokisi'.)

z-m-01-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kwisivakalisi sengxelo kumgca 3, bala icala lasekhohlo 3+4 nelasekunene 7+2 ngokwahlukileyo uze uthelekise.

Ukuba ubala isivakalisi sengxelo kumgca 3, icala lasekhohlo li-7 nelasekunene 7+2 li-9, ngoko alifani. Ngoko isigqibo sakumgca 4 sinzima ukusikholelwa nasco. Okubonayo kuxhomekeke kumgca okhethileyo. Umgca 1 ubaliwe ngokuchanekileyo.

z-m-01-04.s.s2.r.d: Le ngcamango ayinakwahlula 'elifanayo' kwi-'likhulu'. I-'likhulu' ibonakaliswa ngophawu olwahlukileyo.
